Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building sizes, ages, portables, and detailed site plans. Robust condition assessment across all major systems with Facility Condition Index data and lifecycle planning integrated into capital strategy (Facility Condition Assessments pp. 103-120, Site Master Plans pp. 121-198).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections with methodology, demographic analysis, and capacity utilization by site and grade. Explicit connection of enrollment trends to facility needs including TK expansion and space utilization strategies (Enrollment, Capacity, and Utilization Analysis pp. 91-102).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational goals and district mission are clearly integrated with facilities planning. Detailed discussion of educational specifications including support for TK, project-based learning, special education, and flexible learning spaces (District and Community Profile pp. 32-41, Community Engagement Summary pp. 53-90).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: District-wide data and strategies for outdoor greening, resilient schoolyards, permeable surfaces, and outdoor learning are central to the plan. Site master plans include detailed greening and shade strategies framed as climate resilience measures (Climate Readiness pp. 45-52, Site Master Plans pp. 121-198).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Climate readiness is a foundational theme with comprehensive risk assessment and multi-site strategies addressing HVAC, shading, stormwater, and energy resilience. The plan aligns with state adaptation guidance and integrates climate resilience across all phases (Climate Readiness pp. 45-52).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Energy resilience and efficiency are core to the plan with detailed data on energy use, electrification strategies, and compliance with Title 24 and Zero Net Energy goals. Includes plans for solar, battery storage, microgrids, and electrification of HVAC and kitchens (Climate Readiness pp. 45-52, Site Master Plans pp. 121-198).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, phased project prioritization, and multiple funding sources including bonds, state programs, and developer fees. Financial plan includes escalation assumptions, contingencies, and long-term sustainability considerations (Financial Summary & Implementation pp. 199-208).
